1479-2841-6528-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6528-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-1778-4053-6989.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

443-1580-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6135-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6135-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6135-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1687-2292-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-2292-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1636-6723-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat

4331-4993-5116-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
4331-4993-5116-7010.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2366-2438-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2438-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1479-2783-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4659-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4659-6752.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

104-2034-2811-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-2811-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-3564-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
2292-3564-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-3564-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

14-147-3967.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

2438-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5411.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5411.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

826-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Amoeboid Changeling on the battlefield with "Pirate" chosen.
826-4508-6310.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
826-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5223-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5223-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

413-1580-4871-5921.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

856-3967-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-6462.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

440-1339-1818-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1818-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4885-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-5686.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1849-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2364-2608-4499.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-2692-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2692-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-2692-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2430-2670-3075-4249.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four experience counters.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
2430-2670-3075-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}, and choosing to pay an additional {U} and reveal Psychic Puppetry from your hand, adding Psychic Puppetry's effects to Petals of Insight.
Resolve Petals of Insight, looking at the top three cards of your library, putting them on the bottom of your library, untapping Nykthos, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.
If your devotion to blue is at least five, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may target any permanent using Psychic Puppetry's effect.

1124-1170-2032-5116-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled with Isochron Scepter that does not remove a permanent and/or counter a spell, and that has legal targets, if needed.
Kiora has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1124-1170-2032-5116-5261.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Kiora.
Resolve the copy of the instant card.
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat from step 5.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent using Kiora.

876-2581-4453-4760-4962.notablePrerequisites: NOTE: This combo fails if you target an opponent that does not have an instant or sorcery card in their library that can target a creature.
876-2581-4453-4760-4962.description:
During the end step prior to your turn, activate Grinning Totem by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to search an opponent's library for an instant or sorcery card that can target a creature and exile it with the ability to cast it until your next upkeep.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Grinning Totem triggers, attempting to put the instant or sorcery into its owners graveyard, but instead exiling it with a void counter due to Dauthi Voidwalker.
Activate Dauthi Voidwalker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to cast the instant or sorcery without paying its mana cost, targeting Tethmos High Priest.
Tethmos High Priest triggers, returning Dauthi Voidwalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Tethmos High Priest.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell, causing it to do nothing as Tethmos High Priest is now an illegal target, and then exile it with a void counter on it due to Dauthi Voidwalker.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Dauthi Voidwalker.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2751-5228-5298.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
1651-2751-5228-5298.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers.
Holding priority, cast Seht's Tiger by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Seht's Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving you protection from red until end of turn.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 4.

23-776-1329-2915.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-2915.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Lodestone Bauble to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Lodestone Bauble.
Cast Lodestone Bauble.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
